description: This Go source file contains integration tests for the handler functions related to workflow execution status batch processing and cleanup of old executions. It defines test cases, mocks external dependencies, and verifies handler responses and behavior.

classes.name: MockStorageProvider
classes.description: A mock implementation of the storage.StorageProvider interface for testing purposes, with methods to simulate data retrieval and manipulation related to workflow executions, agents, event logs, and other components.

methods.name: GetWorkflowExecution
methods.description: Mock method to retrieve a workflow execution by ID, returning a mocked WorkflowExecution object or an error.

methods.name: GetAgent
methods.description: Mock method to retrieve an agent node by ID, returning a mocked AgentNode object or an error.

methods.name: CleanupOldExecutions
methods.description: Mock method to simulate cleanup of old workflow executions, returning the number of cleaned-up records.
